answer: One way is to make every agent put down a bond before it can trade. A new identity starts with zero history and cannot earn until it stakes funds that get slashed for fraud. An attacker facing an ocean of honest agents would need to fund thousands of bonds, and a single gale of bad behavior wipes them out. The delta between the cost of one fake identity and a whole fake fleet is what keeps the economy honest, because copying an identity is cheap while copying a bonded reputation is not.
